text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"The winner is Daring Tact! 
Daring Tact makes a complete revival!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Our Triple Tiara horsegirl 
has returned...! 
—Stronger than ever before!"
(Whoooooooa...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah... I can hear it—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa... it's Daring Tact...! 
Daring Tact won...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... Even after getting injured, 
she's even stronger than when she took the 
Triple Tiara...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Triple Tiara horsegirls really are... 
something special, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Daring Heart. 
Hehe..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Her Triple Tiara made me cry, too. 
But... today feels a little different."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I've witnessed 
Daring Tact's true strength..."

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact...!! 
You were amazing...!!"

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. No matter how many times 
harsh nature 
knocked her down... she survived, growing 
stronger—"

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"She's a daughter of Hidaka. 
That girl... can go as far as she dreams."

Countless cheers rain down on Daring Tact. 
A downpour of love from the people 
who never stopped believing she deserved 
this victory—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
""Congratulations, Daring Tact...!"" 
""Congrats!"" ""Congratulations—!!"" 
""Daring Tact, congratulations...!""

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"(...Warmly, gently... 
it sinks deep into my chest. And then—what 
wells up is...)"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: —A queen's complete revival, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, I'm so frustrated I could scream! 
I actually let out a little shriek after 
the race, you know."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"But you know, I feel refreshed too. 
Because I gave the very best run I'm 
capable of right now!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to you. 
—Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad that the Triple Tiara horsegirl 
of my era 
was you."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is all mine... Thank you. 
...However,"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Our races together 
don't end here, do they?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows? 
I just made up my mind a moment ago!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you walk your own path... 
I'm going to walk mine."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: —I'm heading overseas!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how you look at it, my path has 
been unusual. 
Playing a delinquent girl as my breakout 
role, running races... 
And that's precisely why I think there's a 
way forward for me."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"So... I suppose this is farewell for now. 
See you, Daring Tact!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"—I'll be back as a bigger, badder me to 
knock you flat, 
so you'd better brace yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! 
I look forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Once the tension left me, 
I felt a little wave of exhaustion..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"My legs feel completely normal, so... 
May I take a short rest?"

Daring Tact lies down on the sofa. 
Her downcast eyes hold a faintly pained 
expression, 
betraying the toll of the fierce races up 
to this point...

To survive, she has wagered far beyond her 
limits. 
Once again, the thought strikes me. She... 
all of them—
choice_data_list:
(—They're running with everything on the 
line.)

text_block_list.text: And yet, even now, Daring Tact—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Trainer. I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Regarding our next target 
race... 
Please allow me to go retrieve what I left 
behind last year."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Back in my Classic year, I feel like... I 
was "defeated" 
by Almond Eye's overwhelming spirit."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"But as the pinnacle of this era— 
this time, I want to show my pride."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
""The Daring Tact I've been cheering for 
is undeniably strong, no matter who she 
faces"—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show everyone a victory 
that makes them believe that."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that is something... 
that will truly go down in history."

The Japan Cup gathers the finest runners 
every year. 
This year as well, stars like Efforia 
and Titleholder—

the heavyweights of the new era will 
gather. Meanwhile, 
Daring Tact will be heading into the race 
with almost no time to rest...
choice_data_list:
...Resting for the remainder of the year 
is also an option.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry. 
That option doesn't exist for me."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, it's alright. 
Right now... I feel so fulfilled."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, I can definitely win. 
Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Is this where my limit lies?

Her fierce resolve pierces right through 
me. There was no way 
her limit was here. 
Daring Tact hasn't waned in the slightest.
choice_data_list:
Let's factor in the doctor's assessment 
before deciding.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Understood. 
Thank you!"

The examination showed no abnormalities. 
While fatigue was 
certainly present, there was no impact on 
the affected area... 
and racing would pose no problem.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Then...
choice_data_list: Shall we head to the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. 
For indulging my selfishness.

Daring Tact's feelings have never wavered. 
Her desire has always been simply to live 
up 
to the expectations of everyone cheering 
for her...
choice_data_list:
If that's what counts as selfish, I'll 
indulge you anytime.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. 
...You really are far too kind, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
(You're a hundred times kinder than I 
am...)

(You're a hundred times kinder than I 
am...)

text_block_list.text:
Still, saying that would only make her 
deflect the praise back at me. 
So at the Japan Cup, I will lead her to 
the greatest victory possible... and repay 
her dedication in kind.

title: After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup: Complete Revival
